INSPECTION PROCEDURE
HINT:
• If OTC P0100 (Mass Air Flow Meter Circuit Malfunction), P0106 (Mass Air Flow Meter Circuit Range/
Performance Problem). P0110 (Intake Air Temp. Circuit Malfunclion), P0115 (Engine Coolant Temp.
Circuit MaHunctlon), P0120 (Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch "A" Circuit Malfunction) are output
simultaneously, E2 (sensor ground) may be open.
• Read freeze frame data using TOYOTA hand-held tester or OBD JI scan tool. Because freeze frame
records the engine conditions when the malfunction Is detected, when troubleshooting it is useful for
determining whether the vehicle was running or stopped, the engine warmed up or not, the air-fuel
ratio lean or rich, etc. at the time of the malfunction.
